subject: Archive quarantine & tombstone schedule for backup purge request
message_1_subject: Request: backup purge & quarantine window for PHI test data
message_1_body:
Hi Olga,

We ran an internal audit and found some staging datasets that contain de-identified PHI derivatives and need a longer soft-delete (tombstone) window before they are physically purged from backups. Our security team also needs an explicit quarantine period for snapshots so legal can validate restoration proofs if regulators ask.

Can Redwood provide a proposal that includes: 1) tombstone (soft-delete) timeframe, 2) quarantine window for backups/snapshots, 3) explicit log retention exceptions (if any) for restore metadata, and 4) a process for DPA amendment or subprocessor disclosure for any backup vendor involved? We need this for MedSure's upcoming audit week (first week of November).

Also attaching a quick inventory. We prefer a DocuSign amendment if needed.

Thanks,
Harper
Director, IT Risk — MedSure Health

Attachments: medsure-inventory-q3.csv (attachment stub)
message_2_subject: Re: Request: backup purge & quarantine window for PHI test data
message_2_body:
Hi Harper — thanks for the heads up and the inventory.

High level proposal from our side (initial, subject to legal review):
- Tombstone (soft-delete) window: 90 days by default, during which data is logically deleted but recoverable for restore/proof.
- Quarantine window (snapshots/backups): 30 days after tombstone trigger for any scheduled snapshots containing the affected objects; snapshots older than that would be eligible for purge.
- Backup purge cadence: weekly incremental retention with monthly full snapshot; purge eligible snapshots run on the second weekend of each month (we can shift if you need earlier).
- Log/metadata retention exception: keep restore-request and verification logs for 180 days; detailed access logs remain at standard retention unless you request an exception.

Action items:
- Kimberly (legal), can you confirm whether we should reduce tombstone to 60 days for MedSure to avoid contract conflicts?
- Marcus (infra), can you validate feasibility of adding a 30-day quarantine flag to snapshots for this account and whether the purge job can skip those tagged snapshots?
- Harper, we'll prepare a draft DPA amendment and a one-page evidence checklist for your auditors.

I attached a proposed purge schedule spreadsheet and a short one-pager draft. If that looks broadly OK I'll loop in legal for redlines and procurement for DocuSign.

—Olga
Head of Customer Compliance, Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-purge-schedule.xlsx, proposed-tombstone-onepager.pdf (attachment stubs)
message_3_subject: Re: Request: backup purge & quarantine window for PHI test data — legal redlines
message_3_body:
Olga / Marcus / Harper —

Thanks, Olga. I reviewed the initial proposal. A couple of legal/compliance notes:
1) Tombstone window: propose 60 days rather than 90 for commercial customers with PHI derivatives, to align with our standard retention carve-outs and limit exposure. If MedSure requires longer we can accept via an appendix (DPA amendment).
2) Quarantine window: 30 days is acceptable; please document the tagging mechanism so we can evidence the state transition (tombstoned -> quarantined -> purged).
3) Log retention exception: 180 days for restore-request metadata is fine, but we need to ensure these logs are stored in a compliant store (encrypted at rest with KMS keys noted in the amendment).

I've prepared a redline to the DPA and a short amendment for subprocessor disclosure. Harper — I'm attaching the redline; when you confirm we can send via DocuSign.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance — Redwood Inference

Attachments: redline-tombstone-proposal.pdf (attachment stub)
message_4_subject: Finalized: tombstone/quarantine schedule + DPA amendment next steps
message_4_body:
Harper — following Kimberly's review we've made the following decisions and next steps (summary):

- Tombstone (soft-delete): 60 days (recovery-only state).
- Snapshot quarantine window: 30 days after tombstone; snapshots older than that are eligible for purge.
- Backup purge cadence: weekly incremental, monthly full; purge jobs will skip snapshots tagged with the MedSure-quarantine flag. Monthly purge job scheduled for second weekend — first run scheduled 2026-11-14 (we can adjust if you need earlier).
- Log retention exception: restore-request metadata and verification logs retained for 180 days in our encrypted audit store (KMS: redwood-prod-kms); access to these logs will be strictly audited.

Next steps:
1) Kimberly will send the redlined amendment to Harper for confirmation.
2) Procurement (cc) — once Harper confirms, expect DocuSign link for signature; the amendment includes explicit subprocessor list for backup vendors.
3) Marcus will implement tagging and confirm the purge job skip logic by 2026-10-28.

Harper, can you confirm that the 60/30/180 plan satisfies MedSure's audit requirement? If yes we'll send the DocuSign and schedule the rollout.

Best,
Olga
Head of Customer Compliance, Redwood Inference
